title: Hudson Tuf-Lite III 3000K Series Hub | Cooling Tower Fans
description: Hudson Tuf-Lite III 3000K Series Hub fan assemblies offer years of cost effective, reliable service. Cooling Tower replacement parts from ICST.

layout.title: Hudson Tuf-Lite III 3000K Series Hub | Cooling Tower Fans

paragraphs: Adjustable Pitch Fan Assembly 11′ Through 14′ Diameter. Blade Counts from 4 to 15.

Hudson Tuf-Lite III 3000K Series Hub (White) fan blades are of single piece fiberglass reinforced plastic (FRP) construction optimized for performance, reliability, noise, and cost effectiveness. Tuf-Lite III fan blades are constructed of light weight, corrosion resistant, fiberglass reinforced vinyl-ester resin, with materials, thickness, and processes determined from finite element analysis modeling. Tuf-Edge leading-edge erosion and UV protection come standard with this blade.
